name: c3vd_endoscopy_splats
title: C3VD colonoscopy scenes as Gaussian splats and point clouds (EndoGSLAM fits from PR-ENDO)
description: Ten colonoscopy sequences of the C3VD phantom dataset reconstructed with EndoGSLAM and released with PR-ENDO (relightable Gaussian splatting for endoscopy): per scene the optimised Gaussian splat (point_cloud.ply with the 3DGS attributes), the Gaussian centres (means3D.ply) and the per-step parameter dumps (.npz / .pt). Read out of the 7.8 GB zip on Zenodo by HTTP Range. The frame is the scene's own camera frame; the scale follows the C3VD phantom (millimetres, TO CONFIRM).

license.note: CC BY 4.0 on the PR-ENDO Zenodo record (checked 2026-10-14); the underlying C3VD dataset is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so commercial use is TO CONFIRM.

citation: Kaleta J., Dall'Alba D., Plotka S., Korzeniowski P. PR-ENDO: Physically Based Relightable Gaussian Splatting for Endoscopy. arXiv:2411.12510, 2024. Bobrow T.L., Golhar M., Vijayan R., et al. Colonoscopy 3D Video Dataset with Paired Depth from 2D-3D Registration. Med Image Anal 90:102956, 2023.

splat.description: Optimised 3-D Gaussian splat (PLY with position, scale, rotation, opacity, SH colour)

points.description: Gaussian centres as a plain point cloud
